title: If something isn't right
facts: Complaints go to slot 4 (main, east) or slot 22 (west); reply within one working day.
A returning car is looked at first and the look is free.
Escalation: slot 2 by e-mail cbrennan@brennanautocare.example (pattern in phones.md).
Account A5's manager called three times in nine days and was never called back: the story breaks this page's promise on purpose.

list_items.item: Call the shop that did the work and ask for the service manager: Greg Whitaker for East Main and Bonny Oaks, Dale Hutchins for Charlotte Pike. Or tell any advisor and they will get him.
You will hear back within one working day, from a person who can fix it.
If the car needs to come back, we look at it first, ahead of the day's other work, and it does not cost you anything to have it looked at.

new_facts: Reply within one working day. Reason: gives stories S1 and S8 a stated standard to be measured against.

notes_for_russian_writer: In Russia a written claim (претензия) has legal weight under the consumer law; say that a written claim is answered within 10 days by law and by phone the same day by the shop's own rule. Record as new facts.
